# reels — agent entrypoint

`reels` is a Python 3.12+, uv-managed, ffmpeg-backed video-process primitive. Phases 0 and 1 are video-only.

## Read first

- `AGENTS.md` — operating rules, command contract, extension seams
- `README.md` — human quickstart
- `docs/PHASES.md` — recording/editing phases and deferred audio boundary
- `docs/SPEC.md` — full document and verifier specification

## Machine-readable contracts

- `schemas/capture/capture-v1.json` — Recording Document (`capture.json`)
- `schemas/reel/reel-v1.json` — Editing Document (`reel.json`)
- `agent.json` — command and capability manifest

## Implementation map

- `src/reels/capture_doc.py` and `src/reels/reel_doc.py` — parsers and serializers
- `src/reels/contracts/verify.py` — recording gate
- `src/reels/contracts/prove.py` — editing/assembly metamorphic contract
- `src/reels/media.py` — ffprobe/ffmpeg facts, including video mean luma
- `src/reels/adapters/` — platform recording adapters
- `src/reels/render.py` — ffmpeg video renderer
- `tests/` — contract and integration tests

## Runtime rule

Run `uv sync` and `uv run reels ...`. Use `--json` for agent consumption. A process exit of 0 is not enough: inspect the persisted `verified` verdict. `unverifiable` is a distinct failure-to-prove state. Audio capture, LUFS/peak measurement, and music ducking are deferred and must not be enabled implicitly.
